commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 33:67.
83' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
80' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
79' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) for a tough tackle.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and George Hirst (Ipswich) replaces Liam Delap.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Jack Taylor (Ipswich) is brought on as a substitute for Omari Hutchinson.
72' Substitution. Manuel Akanji walks off the pitch and Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
72' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Rico Lewis (Manchester City) replaces Mateo Kovacic.
69' 0 - 6 It's in the back of the net! Mateo Kovacic puts the ball on a plate for James McAtee (Manchester City), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 0:6.
67' James McAtee (Manchester City) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

67' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
64' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Ben Godfrey is replaced by Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich).
64' Here's the change. Jens Cajuste leaves the pitch and Massimo Luongo (Ipswich) comes on as a substitute.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) will replace Jack Clarke.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Divin Mubama (Manchester City) comes onto the pitch for Erling Haaland.
63' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Kevin De Bruyne and he is replaced by James McAtee (Manchester City).
63' Here comes a substitution. Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is brought on as a substitute for Phil Foden.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ipswich comes to nothing.
62' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) sends a cross into the box, but Ederson comes off his line to gather the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Ipswich are awarded a corner kick.
60' Phil Foden (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

60' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) serves up a nice cross, but Christian Walton punches the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes a short corner kick.

59' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Christian Walton is alert and denies him. Manchester City have a corner.

57' 0 - 5 Goal! Jeremy Doku manages to prod the ball to Erling Haaland (Manchester City) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:5.
55' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

54' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Kevin De Bruyne, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
49' 0 - 4 Goal! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Christian Walton. He makes it 0:4.
49' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net.
48' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
47' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
46' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) passes the ball onto Phil Foden, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' 0 - 3 Goal! Kevin De Bruyne rounded the goalkeeper and sent a sweet pass to Phil Foden (Manchester City), who had an easy finish to put it into an empty net. 0:3.
40' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.

39' Manchester City are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
30' 0 - 2 Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. The ball rebounds to Phil Foden (Manchester City) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
25' The corner is swung in but Ipswich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' Decent spell from Ipswich here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. Ipswich have been awarded a corner kick.

24' What a chance that is! Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
20' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
20' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
18' Phil Foden (Manchester City) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.

17' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
16' Manchester City fail to score from a corner as Christian Walton (Ipswich) leaps to collect the ball.

15' A tremendous drive by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Christian Walton makes a brilliant save. It will be a corner kick for Manchester City.
8' A first-time shot by Liam Delap (Ipswich) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
4' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich. Ipswich will take a corner kick.
3' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ipswich.
1' The match has just started.
Manchester City will kick the game off.
Samuel Barrott will referee today's match.
